capture_metadata.dialogue_fixture: Production DialoguePanel started with an authored conversation at each character post. Visual state only; no normal interaction or progression proof.

dialogue_presentation_config._comment: P2-081 trainer conversations use enabled; P2-082 NPC portraits and P2-084 NPC openings each use a separate nested flag. Presentation candidates remain off until the same authored posts and panels pass independent native review. No encounter, reward, input, camera or progression changes.

npc_openings._comment: P2-084: distinct openings for four existing speakers. Only line zero changes; route guidance, portraits, conversation IDs, state requirements and completion events remain authored. Bryn's progression briefing is already distinct and is omitted. Native panel review required.

lines.stormwood_elder_maud_arrival: Elder Maud: Listen a moment under the canopy. The Rodfolk learned to read the storm before they laid these roads.
lines.stormwood_elder_maud_in_progress: Elder Maud: A familiar shortcut still deserves care. Root bridges shorten the way, but the Blackwater edge is exposed.
lines.stormwood_elder_maud_post_storm: Elder Maud: I can hear the rain between the leaves again. I had nearly forgotten that sound beneath the thunder.
lines.stormwood_trader_fenn_arrival: Fenn: Going beyond Lantern Hollow? Count your recovery supplies before you count on finding more.
lines.stormwood_trader_fenn_in_progress: Fenn: Supplies first, shortcuts second. The root bridges save a walk, but the Blackwater edge is exposed.
lines.stormwood_trader_fenn_post_storm: Fenn: The Long Storm has ended; the walk to the Fallen Giant is still a walk. Make room for supplies before you leave.
lines.stormwood_trader_oswin_arrival: Oswin: I keep my supplies close to the rod crews. A repair is no use if the tools cannot reach it.
lines.stormwood_trader_oswin_in_progress: Oswin: Before you leave Rodline Post, think about the crossing ahead. The Still Grove is a quiet clearing beyond the Capacitor Grove.
lines.stormwood_trader_oswin_post_storm: Oswin: Lighter rain makes it easier to mind a stall. There are still travellers to supply.
lines.stormwood_warden_elect_bryn_arrival: Warden-Elect Bryn: A road is a promise to the people at the other end. Rodline Post still has promises to keep.
lines.stormwood_warden_elect_bryn_post_storm: Warden-Elect Bryn: The Long Storm has ended. Keeping these roads open is our work now.

npc_portraits._comment: P2-082: match installed portrait plates to each named speaker's unchanged world body profile, including side conversations and the generated Wen refusal. Separate presentation gate; native paired identity review required.

challenge: The Crown's records reward patience. So does a well-read opponent.
Let us put that patience to the test.
defeated: A battle worth remembering. There is always more to learn.
archivist_wen_crown_trial.speaker: Wen

challenge: I build with Stormglass. Spacing matters as much in a fight as in a footing.
Show me the room you leave your companion.
defeated: Well fought. I had best get back to my Stormglass work.
archwright_senn_crown_footing.speaker: Senn

challenge: The Dynamo holds this forest in order. I won't let your team tear that order apart.
Stand ready.
defeated: My team is beaten. Leave me a moment with them.
captain_marrow_dynamo_core.speaker: Captain Marrow

challenge: The Fallen Giant makes a fine place to practise watching a tell.
Let's see who blinks first.
defeated: Well fought. I like the quiet here beside the Fallen Giant.
circuit_lena_giant.speaker: Lena

challenge: Knowing when your companion needs room to recover is part of caring for them.
Let's take this one carefully.
defeated: A good battle. Let us see to our companions.
circuit_mira_lantern.speaker: Mira

challenge: Blackwater leaves little room to drift. Keep an eye on the ravine as well as my team.
Shall we begin?
defeated: The bout is yours. Good travelling along Blackwater.
circuit_orin_blackwater.speaker: Orin

challenge: There's the rod station, and here's our lane. Watch both when the charge builds.
Your team ready?
defeated: Well fought. Keep an eye on the rod station as you go.
circuit_tavi_rodline.speaker: Tavi

challenge: I've carried enough parcels round these pools to know every awkward turn.
Think your team can keep up?
defeated: The bout is yours. I still have a long loop round these pools.
courier_pim_pool_loop.speaker: Pim

challenge: I used to watch the teeth and miss the feet. The first movement tells you more.
Ready to try?
defeated: Well fought. I still have plenty of watching to do.
crown_wayfarer_nell.speaker: Nell

challenge: The Hollows rod stays under Tether control.
Your team will have to get past mine.
defeated: My team is beaten. These woods are harder to hold than I thought.
lieutenant_dace_hollows_rod.speaker: Lieutenant Dace

challenge: This bridge carries the rod line. I decide who crosses.
Bring your team forward.
defeated: My team is beaten. I have nothing more to say.
lieutenant_varga_rodline_bridge.speaker: Lieutenant Varga

challenge: Cross a discharge lane at the wrong moment and you've already lost ground.
Show me your timing.
defeated: The bout is yours. I need a moment with my team.
officer_kestrel_outer_works.speaker: Officer Kestrel

challenge: You can watch the discharge or watch my team. You'll need to do both.
Take your position.
defeated: The bout is yours. I have my own team to look after.
officer_maren_verge_rod.speaker: Officer Maren

challenge: The Deepwood rod is guarded. Don't mistake these trees for cover from us.
My team is ready.
defeated: My team is beaten. Let me see to them.
officer_nysa_deepwood_rod.speaker: Officer Nysa

challenge: You're at the outer works now. Every step brings you closer to the current.
My team will hold this lane.
defeated: My team cannot hold this lane. I will see to them.
outerworks_lieutenant_sera.speaker: Lieutenant Sera

challenge: A pursuer shows its path before it reaches you. Watch where it commits.
Let's put those tracking eyes to work.
defeated: Well fought. I will keep watching the trail.
ranger_pax_sentinel.speaker: Ranger Pax

challenge: Under this canopy, the first surprise isn't always the last.
Let's see how your team recovers.
defeated: Well fought. Under this canopy, it pays to stay ready.
rodfolk_guard_bram.speaker: Bram

challenge: This ash lane leaves little room for a careless step.
Keep your team close and show me your footing.
defeated: Well fought. Take care on the ash lane ahead.
rodfolk_pathfinder_elin.speaker: Elin

challenge: Don't rush to answer the wind-up. Read where the dive is going.
Ready?
defeated: Well fought. Every bout gives me something to practise.
rodline_duelist_ren.speaker: Ren

challenge: I spend my days watching this conduit. The current always has a route.
Where will your team make its stand?
defeated: The bout is yours. I have a conduit to watch.
rodline_keeper_fenn.speaker: Fenn

challenge: Up on the ridge, there's nowhere to hide a change of pace.
Let me see yours.
defeated: Well fought. I will think on that as I walk the ridge.
rodline_scout_kael.speaker: Kael

challenge: The circuit asks more than strength. I want to see how your companions work together.
Show me the team you've brought this far.
defeated: A good battle. Give your companions a rest before the next stop.
rook_circuit_lantern.speaker: Rook

challenge: Out here in the ash ring, you've room to notice the whole fight.
Show me what you've learned.
defeated: A good battle. Rest your companions before you leave the ash ring.
tamsin_ash_ring.speaker: Tamsin

challenge: Watch the shelter, then watch your companion. The storm makes you read both.
Let's see how you move together.
defeated: A good battle. Keep an eye on your companion when the rain thickens.
tamsin_surge_lesson.speaker: Tamsin

challenge: I watch the pool edge when a fight starts. Wet ground punishes a rushed turn.
Care for a bout?
defeated: Well fought. I could use a quiet moment by the pools.
traveller_ivo_lantern_pools.speaker: Ivo

challenge: The moss hides the pool edge here. I keep my eyes on where a step will land.
A bout on the detour?
defeated: Well fought. Mind the moss by the pool edge.
traveller_ivo_moss_detour.speaker: Ivo
